metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2003 · Spirited Away
metas.description: During her family's move to the suburbs, a sullen 10-year-old girl wanders into a world ruled by gods, witches and spirits, and where humans are changed into beasts.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2008 · WALL·E
metas.description: A robot who is responsible for cleaning a waste-covered Earth meets another robot and falls in love with her. Together, they set out on a journey that will alter the fate of mankind.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2009 · Up
metas.description: 78-year-old Carl Fredricksen travels to South America in his house equipped with balloons, inadvertently taking a young stowaway.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2003 · Finding Nemo
metas.description: After his son is captured in the Great Barrier Reef and taken to Sydney, a timid clownfish sets out on a journey to bring him home.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2004 · Howl's Moving Castle
metas.description: When an unconfident young woman is cursed with an old body by a spiteful witch, her only chance of breaking the spell lies with a self-indulgent yet insecure young wizard and his companions in his legged, walking castle.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2001 · Monsters, Inc.
metas.description: In order to power the city, monsters have to scare children so that they scream. However, the children are toxic to the monsters, and after a child gets through, two monsters realize things may not be what they think.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2007 · Ratatouille
metas.description: A rat who can cook makes an unusual alliance with a young kitchen worker at a famous Paris restaurant.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2009 · Mary and Max
metas.description: In 1976 Melbourne, a lonely 8-year-old girl strikes up a correspondence with an unlikely pen pal: a severely obese 44-year-old New Yorker with Asperger's syndrome.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2004 · The Incredibles
metas.description: While trying to lead a quiet suburban life, a family of undercover superheroes are forced into action to save the world.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2007 · Persepolis
metas.description: A precocious and outspoken Iranian girl grows up during the Islamic Revolution.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2008 · Waltz with Bashir
metas.description: An Israeli film director interviews fellow veterans of the 1982 invasion of Lebanon to reconstruct his own memories of his term of service in that conflict.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2001 · Shrek
metas.description: A mean lord exiles fairytale creatures to the swamp of a grumpy ogre, who must go on a quest and rescue a princess for the lord in order to get his land back.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2009 · Fantastic Mr. Fox
metas.description: An urbane fox cannot resist returning to his farm raiding ways and then must help his community survive the farmers' retaliation.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2009 · Evangelion: 2.0 You Can (Not) Advance
metas.description: In the face of increasingly bizarre and powerful Angel attacks, Shinji Ikari and his partner Rei Ayanami are assisted by two new pilots: the fiery Asuka Langley Shikinami and the mysterious Mari Illustrious Makinami.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2009 · Coraline
metas.description: Wandering her rambling old house in her boring new town, a young girl discovers a hidden door to a strangely idealized version of her life that seems too good to be true.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2001 · Cowboy Bebop: The Movie
metas.description: A terrorist explosion releases a deadly virus on the masses, and it's up to the bounty-hunting Bebop crew to catch the cold-blooded culprit.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2003 · Tokyo Godfathers
metas.description: On Christmas Eve, three homeless people living on the streets of Tokyo discover a newborn baby among the trash and set out to find its parents.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2001 · Millennium Actress
metas.description: A TV interviewer and his cameraman meet a former actress and travel through her memories and career.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2007 · Paprika
metas.description: When a machine that allows therapists to enter their patients' dreams is stolen, all hell breaks loose. Only a young female therapist, Paprika, can stop it.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2003 · The Triplets of Belleville
metas.description: When her grandson is kidnapped during the Tour de France, Madame Souza and her beloved pooch Bruno team up with the Belleville Sisters--an aged song-and-dance team from the days of Fred Astaire--to rescue him.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2000 · Vampire Hunter D: Bloodlust
metas.description: In the year 12,090 AD, the dhampir hunter "D" is hired to rescue Charlotte Elbourne from the vampire nobleman Meier Link.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2008 · Kung Fu Panda
metas.description: To everyone's surprise, including his own, Po, an overweight, clumsy panda, is chosen as protector of the Valley of Peace. His suitability will soon be tested as the valley's arch-enemy is on his way.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2008 · Ponyo
metas.description: A five-year-old boy develops a relationship with Ponyo, a young goldfish princess who longs to become a human after falling in love with him.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2006 · The Girl Who Leapt Through Time
metas.description: A high-school girl named Makoto acquires the power to travel back in time, and decides to use it for her own personal benefits. Little does she know that she is affecting the lives of others just as much as she is her own.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2001 · Waking Life
metas.description: A man shuffles through a dream meeting various people and discussing the meanings and purposes of the universe.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2002 · Ice Age
metas.description: Manny the mammoth, Sid the loquacious sloth, and Diego the sabre-toothed tiger go on a comical quest to return a human baby back to his father, across a world on the brink of an ice age.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2005 · Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
metas.description: Wallace and his loyal dog, Gromit, set out to discover the mystery behind the garden sabotage that plagues their village and threatens the annual giant vegetable growing contest.
